name: Voxtral Mini 4B Realtime 2602
purpose: Real-time streaming ASR for live subtitles, private meeting transcription and voice assistants with delay under 500 ms (card).

license.name: Apache-2.0
license.notes: Card metadata: apache-2.0; no LICENSE file in the repo. Canonical Apache-2.0 text read in the Qwen repo (canonical Apache-2.0 text read in https://github.com/QwenLM/Qwen3-ASR/blob/main/LICENSE). Decoder base is Ministral 3 3B.

architecture.kind: AUTOREGRESSIVE streaming: ~970M causal audio encoder + ~3.4B decoder (Ministral 3 base), both sliding-window attention; one text token per 80 ms

strengths: Streaming with tunable delay, 13 languages incl. German
Ministral-style decoder: best streaming candidate for a Tona decoder path
weaknesses: German WER nearly doubles from offline at 480 ms delay
Community ports untested per card; vLLM first

user_reports.summary: A user could not reproduce the published benchmarks; a reply suggests max_new_tokens must cover one token per 80 ms or output is truncated (deletions).

tona_fit.reason: Apache-2.0, 4.4B, fits 16+ GB; the only open model aimed at live streaming with under 500 ms delay. Independent German 6.34 (8 of 8 sets) is behind the offline models; right for live dictation. Decoder is Ministral 3 3B: a Tona Ministral module would serve it.
